theory.overview: A Trie (prefix tree) is a tree-like data structure for storing strings. Each node represents a character, and paths from root to nodes represent prefixes. Tries enable efficient prefix-based operations: search, insert, delete in $O(L)$ where L is string length. Used in autocomplete, spell checking, IP routing, and word games. This chapter covers Trie structure, operations, and applications.

sections.title: Trie Structure
sections.content: Root node (empty). Each node has children (one per possible character) and a flag indicating end of word. Children can be array (fixed size, fast access, memory intensive) or hash map (dynamic, memory efficient). Space: $O(N \times L)$ where N is number of words, L is average length. Common for lowercase letters: 26 children per node.

node.children: array or hash map of char → node
node.isEnd: boolean, true if word ends here

sections.title: Trie Operations
sections.content: Insert: traverse/create nodes for each character. Mark end node. $O(L)$. Search: traverse nodes for each character. Return true if end node reached and isEnd=true. $O(L)$. Starts with: traverse nodes, return true if all characters found (regardless of isEnd). $O(L)$. Delete: find node, unmark isEnd. Optionally prune empty nodes.

sections.title: Trie Applications
sections.content: Autocomplete: suggest completions as user types. Spell checking: find words with given prefix, check if word exists. IP routing: longest prefix match for routing tables. Word games: Boggle, Scrabble word validation. Pattern matching: search for patterns in text. Tries excel at prefix-based queries.

sections.title: Trie Variants
sections.content: Compressed Trie (Radix Tree): merge nodes with single child into one node with combined string. Reduces nodes, saves memory. Suffix Trie: trie of all suffixes of a string. Used for substring search. Suffix Tree: compressed suffix trie. Patricia Trie: compressed trie with path compression. Each variant optimizes for specific use cases.

variants.name: Suffix Tree
variants.use: Compressed suffix trie, efficient substring search

sections.title: Trie vs Hash Set
sections.content: Trie: $O(L)$ operations, supports prefix queries, memory efficient for shared prefixes. Hash Set: $O(1)$ average operations, no prefix support, stores full strings. Choose Trie for prefix-based operations, Hash Set for exact match when prefix queries not needed.

keyConcepts.name: Prefix Sharing
keyConcepts.description: Common prefixes share nodes. 'apple' and 'app' share 'a', 'p', 'p'. This is key to Trie's memory efficiency.
keyConcepts.benefit: Reduces storage for words with common prefixes

keyConcepts.name: isEnd Flag
keyConcepts.description: Marks node where a word ends. Distinguishes 'app' (word) from 'apple' prefix. Essential for distinguishing words from prefixes.

keyConcepts.name: Array vs Hash Map
keyConcepts.description: Array children: O(1) access, fixed size (26 for lowercase). Hash map: dynamic, memory efficient for sparse children.
keyConcepts.tradeoff: Array: fast, memory heavy. Hash: slower, memory efficient

keyConcepts.name: Trie Traversal
keyConcepts.description: DFS to collect all words with given prefix. Useful for autocomplete. Can collect all words or count matches.

complexity.space: $O(N \times L)$ where N words, L avg length

steps.title: Initialize Trie
steps.description: Create root node with empty children and isEnd=false.

steps.title: Insert Word
steps.description: For each character: if child doesn't exist, create it. Move to child. Mark end node.
steps.code: node = root; for char in word: if char not in node.children: node.children[char] = TrieNode(); node = node.children[char]; node.isEnd = true;

steps.title: Search Word
steps.description: Traverse nodes for each character. Return true if end reached and isEnd=true.
steps.code: node = root; for char in word: if char not in node.children: return false; node = node.children[char]; return node.isEnd;

steps.title: Starts With
steps.description: Traverse nodes for each character. Return true if all characters found.
steps.code: node = root; for char in prefix: if char not in node.children: return false; node = node.children[char]; return true;

steps.title: Collect Words
steps.description: DFS from prefix node to collect all words with that prefix.
steps.code: def collect(node, prefix, results): if node.isEnd: results.append(prefix); for char, child in node.children.items(): collect(child, prefix + char, results);

practiceProblems.title: Implement Trie
practiceProblems.description: Implement Trie with insert, search, and startsWith operations.
practiceProblems.solution: TrieNode with children (hash map) and isEnd flag. Insert creates nodes, search checks isEnd, startsWith checks path exists.
practiceProblems.hints: Hash map for children, isEnd flag

practiceProblems.title: Design Add and Search Words
practiceProblems.description: Implement addWord and search with '.' wildcard (matches any character).
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with DFS for wildcard. On '.', try all children recursively.
practiceProblems.hints: DFS for wildcard, try all children

practiceProblems.title: Word Search II
practiceProblems.description: Find all words from dictionary that exist in board (can move in 8 directions).
practiceProblems.solution: Build Trie from dictionary. DFS from each cell, traverse Trie. Remove word from Trie when found.

practiceProblems.title: Replace Words
practiceProblems.description: Replace words in sentence with shortest prefix from dictionary.
practiceProblems.example: dict=['cat','bat','rat'], sentence='the cattle was rattled'. Output: 'the cat was rat'
practiceProblems.solution: Build Trie from dictionary. For each word, find shortest prefix in Trie. Replace if found.
practiceProblems.hints: Trie for dictionary, find shortest prefix

practiceProblems.title: Longest Word in Dictionary
practiceProblems.description: Find longest word that can be built one character at a time from other words.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with isEnd. Sort words by length then lexicographically. Check if all prefixes exist.

practiceProblems.title: Implement Magic Dictionary
practiceProblems.description: Build dictionary, search word with exactly one character different.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie. For search, try changing each character, check if new word exists (and not same as original).
practiceProblems.hints: Try changing each character, check in Trie

practiceProblems.title: Word Squares
practiceProblems.description: Find all word squares (k×k grid where row i = column i as words).
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with prefix lookup. Backtracking to build square row by row.

practiceProblems.title: Stream of Characters
practiceProblems.description: Implement stream checker that checks if any suffix of stream is in word list.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie of words reversed. Maintain stream, check if any suffix matches in Trie.

practiceProblems.title: Prefix and Suffix Search
practiceProblems.description: Design WordFilter with f(prefix, suffix) returning word with that prefix and suffix.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with all prefix-suffix combinations: {prefix#suffix} for each word.

practiceProblems.title: Map Sum Pairs
practiceProblems.description: Implement insert(key, value) and sum(prefix) returning sum of all keys with prefix.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with sum at each node (sum of all values in subtree). Update sums on insert.

practiceProblems.title: Design Search Autocomplete System
practiceProblems.description: Autocomplete with top 3 historical suggestions for each prefix.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with top 3 suggestions at each node. On '#', update counts and resort.
practiceProblems.hints: Store top 3 at each node, update on '#'

practiceProblems.title: Concatenated Words
practiceProblems.description: Find all words that can be formed by concatenating two or more words from list.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie + DP. For each word, check if can be split into other words using Trie.
practiceProblems.hints: Trie + DP, check word can be split

practiceProblems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers
practiceProblems.description: Find maximum XOR of any two numbers in array.
practiceProblems.solution: Bit Trie (32 bits). For each number, find number in Trie that maximizes XOR.
practiceProblems.hints: Bit Trie, maximize XOR bit by bit

practiceProblems.title: Maximum XOR With an Element
practiceProblems.description: For each query, find max XOR with any number ≤ limit.
practiceProblems.solution: Bit Trie. For each query, search Trie respecting limit constraint.

practiceProblems.title: Find Maximum XOR Number
practiceProblems.description: Find maximum XOR of two numbers in array (bit Trie variant).
practiceProblems.solution: Build bit Trie. For each number, find best match for maximum XOR.

practiceProblems.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
practiceProblems.description: Implement Trie with insert, search, delete operations.
practiceProblems.solution: TrieNode with children and isEnd. Delete: unmark isEnd, optionally prune empty nodes.

practiceProblems.title: Add and Search Word
practiceProblems.description: Add word and search with '.' wildcard.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with DFS for wildcard handling.

practiceProblems.title: Design In-Memory File System
practiceProblems.description: Implement ls (list) and mkdir (create directory) with path-like structure.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie-like structure where nodes are directories/files.

practiceProblems.title: Design File System
practiceProblems.description: Implement createPath and getPath with file content.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie with isFile flag and content.

practiceProblems.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
practiceProblems.description: Optimized version with word length grouping.
practiceProblems.solution: Group words by length. For search, only check words of same length.

practiceProblems.title: Word Break
practiceProblems.description: Check if string can be segmented into dictionary words.
practiceProblems.solution: DP. Trie for efficient prefix checking. dp[i] = true if s[0:i] can be segmented.

practiceProblems.title: Word Break II
practiceProblems.description: Return all possible segmentations of string into dictionary words.
practiceProblems.solution: DP + backtracking. Trie for prefix checking. Memoize results.

practiceProblems.title: Palindrome Pairs
practiceProblems.description: Find all pairs of words that concatenate to form palindrome.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie of reversed words. For each word, check all possible palindrome splits.

practiceProblems.title: Short Encoding of Words
practiceProblems.description: Find minimum length encoding where no word is prefix of another's encoding.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie. Words that are prefixes of others don't need separate encoding. Count words that are not prefixes.

practiceProblems.title: Boggle Solver
practiceProblems.description: Find all words in Boggle board using dictionary.
practiceProblems.solution: Trie + DFS. Prune if prefix not in Trie. Mark visited cells.
